scenario: When a new webinar registration lands in the HubSpot form inbox, read the registrant's company size, region and job title, then assign the contact to the right SDR owner and post a heads-up in that rep's Slack channel.
rule_hooks: territory map by region and employee band

scenario: Each 'Request a demo' form submission is read from Gmail notifications, matched against Salesforce accounts, and tagged hot/warm/cold with a Salesforce task created for the owning AE within the SLA window.
rule_hooks: lead scoring thresholds and response SLAs

scenario: Read inbound emails in the partnerships@ inbox from creators asking about sponsorships, log each in a Google Sheet tracker, and route ones above a follower threshold to the social lead while sending a polite template decline to the rest.
rule_hooks: follower count and niche fit criteria

scenario: Scan Zendesk tickets tagged 'email complaint' for recipients who say they never signed up, suppress them in the email platform list, and escalate repeat-domain complaints to the deliverability owner in Slack.
rule_hooks: suppression policy and complaint escalation thresholds

scenario: Read emails arriving at press@ and classify them as media interview requests, analyst briefings, or vendor pitches, forwarding each to the PR manager, AR lead, or archive label accordingly with a priority flag for tier-1 outlets.
rule_hooks: tier-1 media outlet list

scenario: After a trade show, read the badge-scan CSV uploaded to Google Drive, dedupe against Salesforce, and assign each new lead to an AE by booth conversation notes and account ownership, flagging existing-customer scans to their CSM.
rule_hooks: account ownership and booth note keywords

scenario: Read new rows in the 'Content Requests' Google Form sheet from sales and product teams, assign each to a writer in Asana based on content type and current writer load, and set a due date from the requested launch.
rule_hooks: content type to writer mapping and capacity caps

scenario: Read Google Ads policy disapproval notification emails, look up the affected campaign's owner in the campaign tracker sheet, and open a Jira ticket for the owner with severity based on the campaign's daily spend.
rule_hooks: campaign owner roster and spend-based severity

scenario: Review new Intercom conversations sourced from Instagram and X DMs, and route product-support questions to the support queue, purchase-intent messages to sales, and brand-mention praise to the social team for resharing.
rule_hooks: message intent categories

scenario: When channel partners submit co-marketing fund requests via a HubSpot form, check the partner tier and remaining MDF balance in the tracking sheet, then approve within limits, route over-limit asks to the channel marketing director, and reply to the partner.
rule_hooks: partner tier MDF caps

scenario: For each new ebook download recorded in HubSpot, check whether the contact is an open opportunity in Salesforce; enroll net-new leads in the nurture sequence and notify the opportunity owner for in-pipeline contacts instead.
rule_hooks: lifecycle stage and open opportunity status

scenario: Read call-for-speakers submissions for the annual user conference from a Typeform results sheet, reject incomplete or off-topic ones with a template email, and assign remaining ones to track reviewers by topic.
rule_hooks: conference track topics and completeness checks

scenario: Read the weekly hard-bounce export emailed by the email service provider, mark matching HubSpot contacts as invalid, and route bounces from active customer accounts to the CSM to obtain an updated address.
rule_hooks: bounce type and customer status

scenario: Triage Slack messages in #brand-requests asking for logos, decks, or design work, reply with the brand-portal link for standard assets, and create Asana design tasks for custom work with priority by requesting team.
rule_hooks: standard asset catalog and team priority order

scenario: Read new G2 and Capterra review notification emails, log each in the reviews sheet, route reviews of 3 stars or below to the customer success lead for outreach, and queue 5-star reviews for the social team to amplify.
rule_hooks: star rating thresholds

scenario: After a webinar, read the exported Zoom Q&A log, assign unanswered technical questions to the relevant product marketing manager, and send sales-intent questions to the attendee's account owner as Salesforce tasks.
rule_hooks: question topic to PMM ownership map

scenario: Review Intercom bot conversations from the pricing page, check the qualification answers for budget and timeline, and route qualified leads to the round-robin AE queue while sending unqualified ones a self-serve trial link.
rule_hooks: BANT qualification criteria and round-robin order

scenario: Read new registrations for a capacity-limited in-person customer dinner from the event sheet, confirm attendees from target accounts, waitlist others once the cap is reached, and email each registrant their status.
rule_hooks: target account list and venue capacity

scenario: Read invoices from creative and media agencies arriving in the marketing-ap@ inbox, match them to the campaign budget line in the budget sheet, and route to the budget owner for approval or flag overages to the marketing ops manager.
rule_hooks: campaign budget lines and approval limits

scenario: Scan Freshdesk tickets from the privacy form for marketing data deletion or access requests, verify the requester's identity against HubSpot, and assign them to the privacy officer with a due date per the regulatory deadline.
rule_hooks: request type and jurisdiction deadlines

scenario: Read Salesforce leads that SDRs marked 'rejected' this week, check the rejection reason, and either recycle them into a nurture list, reassign to a different territory rep, or flag bad data to marketing ops.
rule_hooks: rejection reason codes

scenario: Read CSM-submitted customer advocacy nominations from a Google Form, check the account's NPS and contract status in Salesforce, and route eligible ones to the customer marketing manager while noting ineligible reasons back to the CSM.
rule_hooks: NPS and renewal eligibility rules

scenario: Review comments on active Facebook and LinkedIn ads collected in a social inbox export, hide spam, escalate complaints to support via Zendesk, and route pricing questions to the sales team in Slack.
rule_hooks: comment category and moderation policy

scenario: Read replies to the monthly customer newsletter landing in newsletter@, forward feature requests to product, route support issues into Zendesk, and process 'remove me' replies as unsubscribes.
rule_hooks: reply intent classification

scenario: Read the daily attribution report sheet for leads with missing or malformed UTM parameters, identify the source campaign from the landing page, and assign fixes to the owning channel manager via Asana tasks.
rule_hooks: UTM naming convention and channel ownership

scenario: Read regional sales reps' requests for local field events submitted through a Jira service desk form, prioritize them by the region's pipeline gap, and assign approved ones to the field marketing manager for that region.
rule_hooks: regional pipeline targets and budget availability

scenario: For each new free-trial signup in the product database export, classify by company domain and employee count, enroll SMB signups in the automated onboarding emails, and assign enterprise signups to a named SDR in HubSpot.
rule_hooks: segment thresholds by employee count

scenario: Read Google Alerts and social listening digest emails for competitor mentions, log notable items in the competitive intel sheet, and ping the product marketing owner for that competitor in Slack when a launch or pricing change is mentioned.
rule_hooks: competitor ownership map and alert keywords

scenario: Read pitches arriving at the company podcast inbox, score them against the season's topic themes and guest criteria, and add strong fits to the booking pipeline in Trello while declining others with a template.
rule_hooks: season topic themes and guest criteria

scenario: After a virtual summit, compare the Zoom attendance report with the registration list, send recordings to no-shows, and route attendees who stayed over 30 minutes from target accounts to their AE for follow-up.
rule_hooks: attendance duration and target account list

scenario: Read regional marketing teams' localization requests from a shared Google Sheet, route each asset to the translation vendor for that language, and flag requests with launch dates inside vendor turnaround to the localization lead.
rule_hooks: language to vendor map and turnaround times

scenario: Read general 'Contact Us' form submissions in HubSpot and route each to sales, support, partnerships, careers, or billing based on the selected topic and message content, creating the record in the right system.
rule_hooks: topic to department routing table

scenario: Read the weekly intent-data report for target accounts, and for accounts crossing the engagement threshold, notify the assigned AE in Slack and add the account to the ABM ad audience list.
rule_hooks: ABM tier list and engagement score threshold

scenario: Read drafted email campaigns submitted for approval in the marketing project board, check them against the send calendar for conflicts and required legal review triggers, and route to legal, the brand reviewer, or straight to scheduling.
rule_hooks: send calendar and legal review triggers

scenario: Read customer referral submissions from the referral form, check that the referred company is not already a customer or open opportunity, create qualified leads in Salesforce tagged to the referrer, and notify ineligible referrers.
rule_hooks: referral eligibility rules

scenario: Review the nightly duplicate-lead report from Salesforce, auto-merge exact email matches, and route fuzzy matches across different owners to marketing ops for manual review.
rule_hooks: matching confidence and owner conflict rules

scenario: Read inbound event sponsorship offers from conference organizers in the events@ inbox, compare audience profile and cost against the annual events plan, and route fits to the events director with a summary while declining off-plan ones.
rule_hooks: target audience profile and sponsorship budget

scenario: Read email-preference center updates exported from the ESP, update subscription categories in HubSpot, and alert the account's CSM in Slack when a strategic customer opts out of all communications.
rule_hooks: subscription categories and strategic account list

scenario: After a co-hosted webinar with a technology partner, read the registrant list, share leads who opted in to partner contact with the partner via the shared sheet, and keep the rest internal assigned to SDRs.
rule_hooks: consent flags and lead-sharing agreement

scenario: Read swag and gift requests posted in Slack #swag-requests by sales and CS, verify the recipient account tier and the requester's quarterly swag budget, and create fulfillment orders in the vendor sheet or route over-budget asks to the field marketing manager.
rule_hooks: account tier gifting limits and per-rep budgets

scenario: After a trade show, the lead-retrieval vendor emails a CSV of booth badge scans with staff notes. The agent creates or updates each lead in Salesforce, tags it with the event campaign, assigns it to the territory rep and posts hot leads to the rep's Slack channel.
rule_hooks: territory map by state/country; hot/warm/cold note keywords; existing-owner precedence

scenario: Each morning the agent reads yesterday's spend for every Google Ads and LinkedIn campaign and compares it with the monthly budget plan in Google Sheets. It pings the channel owner on Slack for campaigns pacing over or under plan, and pauses any campaign above the hard cap.
rule_hooks: budget plan sheet; pacing variance thresholds; hard-cap pause rule

scenario: Social listening alerts for negative brand mentions arrive in a shared inbox. The agent scores each by reach, sentiment and topic (outage, safety, executive, legal), then opens an incident in the comms Asana project and pages the on-call PR lead for severity-1 items.
rule_hooks: severity matrix by follower count and topic; on-call rotation calendar

scenario: Instagram posts that tag the brand are collected in a review sheet. For each eligible post, the agent emails or DMs the creator a usage-rights request, logs consent replies, and moves approved assets into the content library folder with attribution metadata.
rule_hooks: eligibility criteria (no minors, no competitor products); rights-language template; consent status values

scenario: New HubSpot form submissions are screened before they enter nurture. The agent flags submissions from disposable domains, gibberish names or blocked IP ranges, deletes or quarantines them, and forwards borderline cases to marketing ops for review.
rule_hooks: disposable-domain blocklist; field validation patterns; quarantine vs delete thresholds

scenario: Hotels and venues reply by email to an RFP for the annual user conference. The agent extracts capacity, dates, rates and attrition terms into a comparison sheet, rejects venues that miss hard requirements, and sends the event manager a ranked shortlist.
rule_hooks: must-have requirements list; budget ceiling; scoring weights

scenario: Internal requests to marketing ops (list pulls, CRM field changes, form builds) arrive in a Jira intake project. The agent sets priority and due date, assigns each ticket to the right specialist, and bounces back incomplete requests with a list of the missing fields.
rule_hooks: request-type SLA table; specialist skill matrix; required-fields checklist

scenario: Third-party and event-partner contact lists are dropped into a Drive folder for import. The agent checks each file's source documentation and consent basis, excludes contacts in restricted countries, imports compliant rows into HubSpot with a source tag, and routes the rest to legal.
rule_hooks: consent-basis requirements by region; restricted-country list; required provenance fields

scenario: Sales reps submit forms disputing which campaign or rep should get credit for an opportunity. The agent pulls the contact's touchpoint history from Salesforce, applies the attribution policy, updates campaign influence when it's clear, and escalates ambiguous cases to the revenue ops manager.
rule_hooks: attribution model rules (first/last touch windows); dispute decision tree

scenario: A weekly third-party intent-data export lists accounts surging on tracked topics. The agent matches each account to Salesforce, enrolls it in the matching topic ad audience, and alerts the account owner or SDR with the surging topics when the score clears the threshold.
rule_hooks: intent score thresholds; topic-to-campaign map; account ownership

scenario: NPS survey responses sync to a sheet after each quarterly send. The agent suppresses detractors from upsell email campaigns and alerts their CSM, adds promoters to the review-request campaign, and tags passives for a nurture track.
rule_hooks: NPS score bands; campaign suppression lists; CSM ownership

scenario: The direct mail vendor sends a weekly file of returned or undeliverable pieces. The agent marks each address invalid in the CRM, removes the contact from upcoming mail drops, and creates address-research tasks for SDRs on high-value target accounts.
rule_hooks: return reason codes; target-account tier list; address status field values

scenario: Inbound replies to promotional SMS campaigns arrive in the texting platform. The agent processes STOP/HELP keywords, routes product questions to support, sends buying-intent replies to the owning rep, and logs each disposition.
rule_hooks: carrier keyword compliance list; intent keyword patterns; owner lookup

scenario: Employees and partners report incorrect logo use, outdated branding or unauthorized trademark use through a brand-feedback form. The agent classifies each report by offender type and severity, emails partner-managers or resellers the correct guidelines, and escalates trademark issues to legal.
rule_hooks: brand guideline violation categories; partner vs third-party handling; legal escalation criteria

scenario: A content-syndication vendor delivers batches of leads under a cost-per-lead contract. The agent checks each lead against the ICP and contract filters (title, company size, geography, duplicates), imports accepted leads, and emails the vendor a rejection file with reason codes for credit.
rule_hooks: contracted lead criteria; ICP firmographic filters; rejection reason codes

scenario: Applications to the affiliate program arrive through the partner portal. The agent reviews each applicant's website category, traffic estimate and promotion methods, approves qualifying ones at the right commission tier, rejects coupon or brand-bidding sites, and sends the matching templated email.
rule_hooks: prohibited promotion methods; traffic thresholds per tier; approval/rejection templates

scenario: Replies to SEO link-building outreach land in a dedicated Gmail inbox. The agent classifies each as accepted, asking for content, asking for payment, or declined, updates the outreach tracker sheet, and sends accepted placements to the content writer.
rule_hooks: reply classification rules; no-paid-links policy; domain authority minimum

scenario: Invitations to enter industry awards and 'best of' lists arrive by email. The agent records the deadline, entry fee and category fit in a tracker, declines pay-to-play or low-fit awards, and assigns qualifying ones to a content owner with a due date ahead of the deadline.
rule_hooks: entry fee ceiling; category relevance list; lead-time rule before deadline

scenario: Requests from industry analyst firms (briefing requests, survey invitations, fact-check drafts) arrive in the analyst-relations inbox. The agent logs each in the AR tracker, routes it to the right product marketing manager, and flags fact-check deadlines within five days.
rule_hooks: analyst firm tier list; product-area ownership; deadline urgency rules

scenario: Conference registrants enter dietary, accessibility or interpreter needs on the registration form. The agent groups the requests, sends catering and venue the counts and special cases they need, confirms with each attendee, and escalates requests that need extra budget.
rule_hooks: accommodation category map; vendor contact per category; cost approval threshold

scenario: Paid attendees email to cancel or transfer conference tickets. The agent checks purchase date and ticket type against the refund policy, issues the full or partial refund or processes the name transfer in the ticketing system, and replies with the outcome.
rule_hooks: refund tiers by days before event; non-refundable ticket types; transfer rules

scenario: Event sponsors upload logos, booth descriptions and ad copy to a shared submission form. The agent checks each submission against package entitlements and file specs, approves compliant ones into the event site queue, and emails sponsors precise fix requests for the rest.
rule_hooks: sponsor package deliverables; file format and size specs; submission deadline

scenario: Weekly paid search query reports list new search terms that triggered ads. The agent adds irrelevant terms as negatives, flags competitor-brand and trademark terms for legal-policy review, and suggests high-converting terms to the PPC manager as new keywords.
rule_hooks: irrelevance keyword patterns; competitor trademark list; conversion thresholds

scenario: Designers submit new display and social ad creatives to an Asana review project. The agent checks dimensions, file size, text ratio and required disclaimers for each target platform, then routes passing creatives to the channel approver and returns failures with the specific violations.
rule_hooks: platform spec sheets; required legal disclaimers by offer type; approver per channel

scenario: Channel partners submit market development fund claims with invoices and proof of performance. The agent checks each claim against the partner's approved MDF plan and remaining balance, approves complete claims for payment in QuickBooks, and asks partners for missing proof.
rule_hooks: MDF policy eligible activities; partner fund balances; proof-of-performance requirements

scenario: Post-event survey responses arrive from a field event series. The agent sends low session or venue ratings to the event manager, routes attendees who checked 'talk to sales' to their account owner, and tags testimonial-worthy comments for the content team.
rule_hooks: rating thresholds; sales-interest flag; testimonial keyword criteria

scenario: Seed-list inbox-placement tests run before major email sends and post results to Slack. The agent reads placement by mailbox provider, holds the scheduled send and alerts email ops when spam placement exceeds the threshold, and logs results for trend review.
rule_hooks: placement thresholds per provider; send-hold criteria; escalation contacts

scenario: New email sends are scheduled in the marketing calendar by several program managers. The agent checks each one's audience overlap against the contact frequency cap and other sends already booked that week, and routes conflicts to the campaign managers to reschedule.
rule_hooks: weekly frequency cap per segment; send priority ranking; calendar ownership

scenario: Customers apply through a web form to join the customer advisory board. The agent checks each applicant's account tier, title seniority and account health in the CRM, shortlists qualified applicants for the program manager, and sends a polite waitlist reply to the others.
rule_hooks: eligibility criteria (ARR tier, seniority); seat limits per segment; account health flags

scenario: During live webinars, attendees email or chat about audio, login or link problems. The agent matches each person to their Zoom registration, resends the correct join link or dial-in, sends recurring issues to the producer in Slack, and tags affected registrants for the recording follow-up.
rule_hooks: issue type playbook; registration lookup; escalation threshold for repeated issues

scenario: Customers write to support about campaign promo codes that won't apply. The agent looks up the code in the promotions sheet, checks expiry, eligibility and usage limits, replies with the fix or an approved substitute code, and escalates codes that are misconfigured in billing.
rule_hooks: promo code registry; eligibility rules; substitute-code authority limits

scenario: Entries for a social media giveaway are collected in a form and sheet. The agent removes ineligible entries (excluded countries, employees, duplicates, missing required actions), picks winners per the official rules, and sends winner notification emails.
rule_hooks: official contest rules; eligibility exclusions; one-entry-per-person rule

scenario: Job-change alerts and 'no longer with the company' bounce-backs show that known customer champions have moved. The agent updates the old contact, creates a contact at the new company, and assigns a warm-outreach task to that account's owner when it's an ICP fit.
rule_hooks: ICP fit criteria; champion definition (role, engagement); account ownership

scenario: Marketers request new tools or add-on seats through a procurement form. The agent checks the existing martech stack for overlapping tools, routes requests that touch customer data to security review, and sends each to the approver required for its annual cost.
rule_hooks: martech stack inventory; data-handling review triggers; spend approval thresholds

scenario: Ad sales reps from publishers and media networks send unsolicited sponsorship and ad placement pitches. The agent declines vendors outside the target audience or on the do-not-buy list, logs promising ones in the media plan sheet, and forwards them to the paid media manager.
rule_hooks: approved/do-not-buy vendor list; audience fit criteria; budget cycle timing

scenario: Regional teams and employees submit draft posts for the corporate LinkedIn and X accounts. The agent checks each draft for banned claims, required disclosures and content-calendar conflicts, schedules approved posts, and routes posts with performance or pricing claims to legal.
rule_hooks: social media policy; claims requiring legal review; calendar slot rules

scenario: Agency staff and internal marketers request access to Google Ads, Meta Business Manager or LinkedIn Campaign Manager. The agent checks each requester against the approved agency roster and role matrix, grants the right permission level, and denies and logs requests from unapproved accounts.
rule_hooks: approved roster; role-to-permission matrix; offboarding list

scenario: Channel partners register referred leads through the partner portal. The agent checks each registration against existing CRM leads and open opportunities, approves new ones and routes them to the partner manager, and rejects or escalates conflicts with the evidence.
rule_hooks: deal registration policy; conflict window (e.g., 90 days); ownership precedence

scenario: Visitor reports from the website feedback widget (broken links, wrong pricing, form errors, typos) collect in a queue. The agent classifies each report, files bugs with the web team, sends content errors to the page owner, and treats pricing or legal inaccuracies as urgent.
rule_hooks: issue category map; page ownership registry; urgent-issue criteria

scenario: The rank-tracking tool emails alerts when tracked keywords drop. The agent ties each drop to its landing page, works out severity from traffic value and size of the drop, and opens a ticket for the page's content owner with priority and the competing URLs that rose.
rule_hooks: keyword priority tiers; position-drop thresholds; page owner map
